implausibleRosterWindows.note: roster size fell below the 485-name plausibility floor established by comparing against qzzcl's stable 487-507 range over the same calendar years

sharedAncestryCaveat: Both sources' READMEs trace their base file to the same origin (Andreas Clenow's 'Trading Evolved' companion CSV, independently hand-maintained against Wikipedia since ~2019-2021). Agreement is evidence against maintenance-divergence errors, not proof of two statistically independent primary sources.

crossCheckWindow.note: agreementRate is computed only over legs where the secondary source's roster was plausible at that date; see secondarySource.implausibleRosterWindows for the excluded span.

singleSourceExtension.note: qzzcl is unmaintained past its coverage end; this window has no cross-check and carries lower confidence.

uncoveredGap.note: Neither source has any membership record in this window. Not extrapolated, not filled -- reported as a hard gap.
